title: Roblox launches real-time AI "chat rephrasing", which replaces banned words with "more respectful language", instead of using the traditional # symbol (Stevie Bonifield/The Verge)
summary: Stevie Bonifield / The Verge: Roblox launches real-time AI “chat rephrasing”, which replaces banned words with “more respectful language”, instead of using the traditional # symbol — Real-time chat rephrasing removes or alters banned words and phrases in messages.
contentText:
Stevie Bonifield / The Verge :

Roblox launches real-time AI “chat rephrasing”, which replaces banned words with “more respectful language”, instead of using the traditional # symbol   —  Real-time chat rephrasing removes or alters banned words and phrases in messages.
